Source Monster

Monster: Basarios | CR: 6 | Tier: 2

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

Stamina Drain. When you hit a creature with this weapon, its speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of your next turn.

Armor Effect

You have advantage on @skill[Stealth] checks made to hide in rocky terrain while you wear this armor.

Tags: mechanic:advantage
